usamo-1972-q1.summary: For positive integers $a,b,c$, write $G=\gcd(a,b,c)$ and $L=\operatorname{lcm}(a,b,c)$. Prove that $G^2\prod_{\rm cyc}\operatorname{lcm}(a,b)=L^2\prod_{\rm cyc}\gcd(a,b)$, where the products run over the pairs $(a,b),(b,c),(c,a)$.
usamo-1972-q1.summaryZh: 给定正整数 $a,b,c$，令 $G=\gcd(a,b,c),L=\operatorname{lcm}(a,b,c)$。分别对 $(a,b),(b,c),(c,a)$ 三对取积，证明 $G^2\prod_{\rm cyc}\operatorname{lcm}(a,b)=L^2\prod_{\rm cyc}\gcd(a,b)$。
usamo-1972-q1.answer: Each prime has the same exponent in the two products.
usamo-1972-q1.answerZh: 每个素数在等式两边的指数都相同。

methods.title: Order three exponents

topics.zh: 最大公因数与最小公倍数

steps: Fix a prime $p$ and sort its exponents in $a,b,c$ as $u\le v\le w$. The three pairwise maximum exponents are $v,w,w$ and the three pairwise minima are $u,u,v$.
The exponent on the left is $2u+v+2w$. On the right it is $2w+2u+v$. This holds for every $p$, so unique factorisation gives equality.
stepsZh: 固定素数 $p$，把它在 $a,b,c$ 中的指数从小到大记为 $u\le v\le w$。三对数中，较大指数依次构成 $v,w,w$，较小指数构成 $u,u,v$。
左边中 $p$ 的指数为 $2u+v+2w$，右边为 $2w+2u+v$。每个素数的指数都相等，由素因数分解的唯一性即得结论。

usamo-1972-q2.summary: In a tetrahedron of positive volume the edges come in three equal opposite pairs. Prove that all twelve face angles are acute.
usamo-1972-q2.summaryZh: 一个体积为正的四面体有三组对棱，每一组中的两条棱等长。证明各个面的十二个内角全是锐角。
usamo-1972-q2.answer: Every face is an acute triangle.
usamo-1972-q2.answerZh: 每一个面都是锐角三角形。

methods.title: Compare a median with half a side
steps: To test $\angle BAC$, take the midpoint $M$ of $BC$. Triangles $ABC$ and $DCB$ match by SSS, with $A$ corresponding to $D$, so $AM=DM$. The path $AMD$ bends because a nondegenerate tetrahedron cannot have $A,M,D$ collinear. Thus $2AM>AD=BC=2BM$.

The vectors $\overrightarrow{AB}=\overrightarrow{AM}+\overrightarrow{MB}$ and $\overrightarrow{AC}=\overrightarrow{AM}-\overrightarrow{MB}$ have dot product $AM^2-BM^2>0$. Hence $\angle BAC$ is acute. We may give the same labels to any chosen face angle.
stepsZh: 先考察 $\angle BAC$。取 $BC$ 的中点 $M$，由三边对应相等，三角形 $ABC$ 与 $DCB$ 全等，因而 $AM=DM$。若 $A,M,D$ 共线，四个顶点将共面，故三角不等式严格成立，给出 $2AM>AD=BC=2BM$。
向量 $\overrightarrow{AB}=\overrightarrow{AM}+\overrightarrow{MB}$ 与 $\overrightarrow{AC}=\overrightarrow{AM}-\overrightarrow{MB}$ 的内积为 $AM^2-BM^2>0$，所以 $\angle BAC$ 为锐角。对任意面角重新命名顶点，即可同理证明。

methods.title: Three perpendicular directions
methods.titleZh: 找出三个相互垂直的方向
steps: Use the centroid as origin and the same letters for the position vectors. Put $u=(A+B)/2$, $v=(A+C)/2$, $w=(A+D)/2$. Since $A+B+C+D=0$, the four vertices have vectors $u+v+w$, $u-v-w$, $-u+v-w$, $-u-v+w$.

The equality $AB=CD$ says $|v+w|=|v-w|$, giving $v\cdot w=0$. The other two opposite-edge equalities give $u\cdot w=u\cdot v=0$. All three vectors are nonzero since otherwise the tetrahedron lies in a plane.
Put $U=|u|^2,V=|v|^2,W=|w|^2$. In every face the squared side lengths are $4(U+V),4(V+W),4(W+U)$. The sum of any two exceeds the third by $8U,8V$, or $8W$. By the cosine rule all angles are acute.
stepsZh: 以重心为原点，用顶点字母表示位置向量。令 $u=(A+B)/2,v=(A+C)/2,w=(A+D)/2$。因 $A+B+C+D=0$，四个顶点依次为 $u+v+w,u-v-w,-u+v-w,-u-v+w$。
条件 $AB=CD$ 给出 $|v+w|=|v-w|$，从而 $v\cdot w=0$。另两组对棱同理给出 $u\cdot w=u\cdot v=0$。三个向量均非零，否则四个顶点共面。
记 $U=|u|^2,V=|v|^2,W=|w|^2$。各面三边的平方为 $4(U+V),4(V+W),4(W+U)$。任两项的和减去第三项总是 $8U,8V,8W$ 中的一个正数。根据余弦定理，三个角全是锐角。

usamo-1972-q3.summary: Draw independently $n>1$ times, each draw uniform on the digits from $1$ to $9$. With what probability is the product a multiple of ten?
usamo-1972-q3.summaryZh: 从 $1$ 到 $9$ 的数字中等可能地独立抽取 $n>1$ 次。所得数字的乘积是十的倍数的概率是多少？

methods.title: Count the two ways divisibility can fail
methods.titleZh: 容斥计算两种不满足条件的情形
steps: A factor of five must come from the digit $5$. A factor of two must come from one of $2,4,6,8$. Denote the absence of a five by $F$ and the absence of an even digit by $E$.
There are eight choices per draw on $F$, five on $E$, and four on $F\cap E$ (namely $1,3,7,9$). Thus the desired probability is $1-\Pr(F)-\Pr(E)+\Pr(F\cap E)=1-(8/9)^n-(5/9)^n+(4/9)^n$.
stepsZh: 乘积的因子 $5$ 只能来自数字 $5$；因子 $2$ 则一定来自 $2,4,6,8$ 中的一个。设 $F$ 表示从未抽到 $5$，$E$ 表示从未抽到偶数。
在 $F$ 中每次有八种选择，在 $E$ 中有五种，在 $F\cap E$ 中有四种，即 $1,3,7,9$。应用容斥原理，所求概率为 $1-\Pr(F)-\Pr(E)+\Pr(F\cap E)=1-(8/9)^n-(5/9)^n+(4/9)^n$。

methods.title: Condition on the positions of the fives
methods.titleZh: 按数字五出现的位置分类
steps: If exactly $j\ge1$ entries are fives, choose their positions in $\binom nj$ ways. To fill the other positions choose from the eight other digits, discarding the $4^{n-j}$ fillings using only odd digits. This gives $\binom nj(8^{n-j}-4^{n-j})$ valid sequences.
Summing from $j=1$ to $n$ gives $(9^n-8^n)-(5^n-4^n)$ by the binomial theorem. Divide by the total count $9^n$.
stepsZh: 设恰有 $j\ge1$ 个位置取到 $5$，选择这些位置有 $\binom nj$ 种方式。其他位置可从八种数字中选，但须去掉只使用四种奇数的 $4^{n-j}$ 种填法。相应的合格序列数为 $\binom nj(8^{n-j}-4^{n-j})$。
对 $j=1,\ldots,n$ 求和，利用二项式定理得 $(9^n-8^n)-(5^n-4^n)$，再除以序列总数 $9^n$。

usamo-1972-q4.summary: Construct a rational function $F(x)=(ax^2+bx+c)/(dx^2+ex+f)$ with integer coefficients that moves every nonnegative rational $x$ strictly closer to $\sqrt[3]{2}$, in absolute distance.
usamo-1972-q4.summaryZh: 构造整数系数的有理函数 $F(x)=(ax^2+bx+c)/(dx^2+ex+f)$，使任意非负有理数 $x$ 代入后，$F(x)$ 到 $\sqrt[3]{2}$ 的距离严格小于 $x$ 到它的距离。

methods.title: Correct a guess using the cubic residual
methods.titleZh: 用三次方程的残差修正估计
steps: Let $k=\sqrt[3]2$. The correction $F(x)=x-(x^3-2)/(x+2)^2$ has the advertised form after cancellation of the cubic term, with positive denominator on $x\ge0$.

The difference of cubes gives $F(x)-k=(x-k)(1-(x^2+kx+k^2)/(x+2)^2)$. The quotient inside the parentheses is positive and less than one: the difference of its denominator and numerator is $(4-k)x+4-k^2>0$ because $0<k<2$.

For a rational $x$ we have $x\ne k$: if $p^3=2q^3$ for positive integers $p,q$, the exponents of $2$ disagree modulo three. Thus multiplying $|x-k|$ by the strictly intermediate factor makes the error smaller, also at $x=0$.
stepsZh: 令 $k=\sqrt[3]2$。考虑修正 $F(x)=x-(x^3-2)/(x+2)^2$。通分后三次项相消，得到答案中的函数，且 $x\ge0$ 时分母为正。
立方差分解给出 $F(x)-k=(x-k)(1-(x^2+kx+k^2)/(x+2)^2)$。括号中的分式严格介于零与一之间，因为分子为正，且分母减分子为 $(4-k)x+4-k^2>0$，这里用到 $0<k<2$。
有理数 $x$ 不会等于 $k$：若正整数满足 $p^3=2q^3$，两边素因数 $2$ 的指数模三分别为零与一，矛盾。因此把 $|x-k|$ 乘以严格介于零与一之间的因子会使误差严格减小，$x=0$ 时也成立。

usamo-1972-q5.summary: Each triple of consecutive vertices of a convex pentagon spans a triangle of area $1$. Prove the area of the whole pentagon is determined, find it, and show that infinitely many distinct congruence classes have this property.
usamo-1972-q5.summaryZh: 凸五边形的每三个连续顶点所成的三角形面积均为 $1$。证明五边形的面积由此确定，求出此面积，并证明满足条件的五边形有无穷多种互不全等的情形。
usamo-1972-q5.answer: The area is $(5+\sqrt5)/2$. Area-preserving stretches give infinitely many incongruent examples.
usamo-1972-q5.answerZh: 面积为 $(5+\sqrt5)/2$。通过保持面积的伸缩变换可得到无穷多个互不全等的例子。

methods.title: Use coordinates adapted to two adjacent sides
methods.titleZh: 用两条邻边建立仿射坐标
steps: Label the vertices $A,B,C,D,E$ in positive order. Use $A$ as origin and $AB,AE$ as coordinate vectors, so $A=(0,0),B=(1,0),E=(0,1)$. Their coordinate parallelogram has actual area $2$, because $[ABE]=1$. Hence the actual oriented area of a triangle is the determinant of its two coordinate difference vectors.

From $[ABC]=[DEA]=1$ get $C=(u,1)$ and $D=(1,v)$. Convexity puts $u,v>0$ since $C$ lies to the right of $AE$ and $D$ above $AB$ in these coordinates. The equations $[BCD]=[CDE]=1$ now become $(u-1)v=1$ and $u(v-1)=1$. Subtraction gives $u=v$, then $u^2-u-1=0$, so $u=(1+\sqrt5)/2$.
Cut along $AC$ and $AD$. The three triangle areas are $1$, $\det(C,D)=u^2-1$, and $1$. Their sum is $u^2+1=(5+\sqrt5)/2$.

For existence, use the listed coordinate points with basis $(1,0),(0,2)$ in the physical plane. The rays from $A$ to $B,C,D,E$ occur in that order (their coordinate slopes are $0,1/u,u,\infty$), so the polygon is simple. Every consecutive turn has strictly positive determinant by the five area calculations, proving convexity. Applying $(x,y)\mapsto(tx,y/t)$ for $t>0$ preserves all areas and convexity. The image of $AB$ has length $t$, so this family has unbounded diameter. A finite set of congruence classes would have bounded diameter.
stepsZh: 将顶点按逆时针次序记为 $A,B,C,D,E$。以 $A$ 为原点，以 $AB,AE$ 为基向量，则 $A=(0,0),B=(1,0),E=(0,1)$。因 $[ABE]=1$，这组基向量张成的平行四边形实际面积为 $2$。因此，用坐标差构成的行列式恰好给出三角形实际的有向面积。
由 $[ABC]=[DEA]=1$ 得 $C=(u,1),D=(1,v)$。凸性保证 $C$ 在直线 $AE$ 右侧、$D$ 在 $AB$ 上方，故 $u,v>0$。条件 $[BCD]=[CDE]=1$ 化为 $(u-1)v=1$ 和 $u(v-1)=1$。两式相减得 $u=v$，于是 $u^2-u-1=0$，取正根 $u=(1+\sqrt5)/2$。
连接 $AC,AD$，得到三个三角形，其面积分别为 $1,\det(C,D)=u^2-1,1$。五边形面积为 $u^2+1=(5+\sqrt5)/2$。

验证存在性时，可在实际平面内取基向量 $(1,0),(0,2)$，按上述坐标作五点。在基坐标中，从 $A$ 到 $B,C,D,E$ 的射线斜率依次是 $0,1/u,u,\infty$，故按此顺序连接不自交。前述五组面积计算给出的有向行列式全为正，所以每次转向都是左转，五边形为凸。施以变换 $(x,y)\mapsto(tx,y/t)$，其中 $t>0$，凸性和面积均保持。边 $AB$ 的像长为 $t$，故这一族五边形的直径无上界，而有限多个全等类的直径必有上界。
